routes.intro: Five requests come up again and again, and for four of them the page already exists. It saves you the 48 hour wait.

inscription.title: I want to apply
inscription.body: The application takes five minutes. You pick your session, your discipline and your length of stay. No payment at this stage.

famille.title: I am coming with my family
famille.body: One parent with a child aged 8 to 17, adapted programme and dedicated package. It is a separate track.

groupe.title: I am coming with my club
groupe.body: From five people up it is a tailored quote, not a standard application. Ruslan calls back to scope it.

logistique.title: Visa, flights, budget
logistique.body: The Russian visa and the domestic flight from Istanbul are included. Everything else is spelled out, with figures.

presse.title: Press or partnership
presse.body: Interview, feature, brand collaboration, referral code for your gym. Write to us with the right subject.

faq.title: BEFORE YOU WRITE
faq.image_alt: A coach wrapping the hands of a smiling fighter before training

delay.question: How fast do you reply?
delay.answer: Within 48 hours on the form. WhatsApp stays the fastest channel, because the message lands straight on Ruslan's phone. If nothing has arrived after 48 hours, check your spam folder before chasing: the reply comes from the mkrcamp.com domain.

language.question: Can I write in English?
language.answer: Yes. Ruslan answers in English and in French, on every channel. The whole site exists in English too, including the application form and the Caucasus guide in PDF.

who.question: Who reads my messages?
who.answer: Ruslan Mukhtarov, the founder of the camp. There is no switchboard and no customer service layer in between. He also runs the selection call and validates the files, so the person you write to is the person you will face.

followup.question: I have already applied, how do I follow up?
followup.answer: The simplest way is to reply directly to the confirmation email you received, so your file stays in the same thread. Otherwise write on WhatsApp with your first name, last name and the session you are aiming for: Ruslan will find the file straight away.

call.question: Can I call you directly?
call.answer: We prefer writing on WhatsApp: Ruslan is often on the mats or travelling, and a message does not get lost. To speak face to face, the fifteen minute video call can be booked once your application is in. That call is what validates your file.

cancel.question: How do I cancel or change my file?
cancel.answer: A link to release your place sits in the reminder email: one click and the place frees up. To change session, discipline or length of stay, write to us. It is done by hand and at no cost as long as the file is not settled.

visio.text: Would you rather talk it through?
visio.note: The call doubles as the selection interview if you apply afterwards.
